parsing_traps: Fiscal year: this is the FY2025 Annual Report (year ended 31 December 2025) even though the folder hints FY2025 and the chairman letter is dated into 2026; bold columns in 5-year tables are 2025

Portfolio-level trade-sector table (p.31) is parsed with retail and business-park columns MERGED into single cells (e.g. 'Food & Beverage Electronics | 27.3% | 6.0%'); values were disentangled using segment subtotals (Retail 69.3 + BP 27.0 + Logistics 3.7 = 100.0) - each sub-list sums exactly to its segment total
Per-property GR/NPI tables (pp.26-27) are on 100% stake basis, while top-tenant GRI% and trade-sector GRI% are on CLCT effective-interest basis - mixing bases silently is a trap

'Term of lease' in the Consolidated Portfolio Statement is the LAND USE RIGHT (land lease), not tenant leases; several Beijing malls have dual expiry dates (e.g. 23 Aug 2044 / 23 Aug 2054) because retail and other-use portions of the land grant expire at different dates, hence term ranges like '40 - 50'
Two 'Total Valuation for Retail' rows on p.28 (incl. vs excl. CapitaMall Yuhuating for 2024 comparative); FY2025 portfolio disclosures exclude Yuhuating throughout per footnote on p.4
Rock Square purchase price footnote: 51% stake at RMB3,340.7m (2018) and 49% stake at RMB3,400.0m (2020) are BOTH expressed on a 100% basis - they are not additive
Statistics of Unitholdings (p.174) is as at 24 February 2026, not FY-end; market cap differs from the 31 Dec 2025 figure

Income statement has no separate 'Gross Revenue' note: the split (gross rental income / other income) and expense lines are on the face of the Consolidated Statement of Total Return (p.95); only 'Other property operating expenses' has a detail note (Note 19, p.148). Note 19 detail rows sum to the S$55,430k face line - do not double count the aggregate
Top-10 tenant percentages are unusually small (1.8% max) because the denominator is total portfolio GRI across 3,159 leases; total top-10 = 9.0% of GRI (stated, p.31)
Shanghai Fengxian/Wuhan Yangluo/Kunshan Bacheng lease counts exclude ancillary buildings (footnotes)
